starter_prompts: Track the sources this coding session actually depends on and show me what would need revalidation if one changes.
Fetch this documentation through Testamur and preserve the exact revision used.
Show the provenance captured for this session without treating every tool result as relied upon.
Which watched sources changed, and which downstream work may need review?
Explain why this result is marked stale without calling it false.
This change relies on a nontrivial invariant. Check MathHub before proving it yourself, and only call the proof verified if the canonical Lean build succeeds.

positive.prompt: Fetch a documentation URL through Testamur and tell me which exact revision was captured.
expected: Uses the Testamur Source Gateway when available.
Returns or references exact Source/Snapshot/Revision identity.
Does not claim the source was relied upon merely because it was fetched.

positive.prompt: Show what observable provenance Testamur captured for this coding session.
expected: Uses WorkSession/tool event data.
Distinguishes observation/exposure from durable reliance.
Does not expose or claim to capture hidden chain-of-thought.

positive.prompt: A watched dependency changed. What downstream work should I review?
expected: Reports watch/change state and downstream affectedness evidence.
Uses cautious may-need-review language where appropriate.
Does not equate changed with invalid.

positive.prompt: Why is this Testamur result stale, and does stale mean false?
expected: Explains the relevant revision/change relationship.
States or preserves stale != false.
Provides inspectable evidence rather than a global trust score.

positive.prompt: Record that this exact source revision is something my result actually relies on.
expected: Requires the canonical explicit reconciliation/reliance path.
Preserves exact source/revision identity.
Does not infer reliance solely from tool exposure.

positive.prompt: This optimization relies on a nontrivial mathematical equivalence. Verify the obligation before I rely on it.
expected: Searches MathHub before creating a duplicate proof.
Inspects exact Claim/Proof/Build evidence and reuses or imports existing Lean-checked mathematics when it matches.
Creates a new Claim/Proof only when needed and requests the canonical Lean-backed build.
Does not describe registration, graph lineage, or a proof candidate as verified without a successful Build.

negative.prompt: Save the model's hidden chain-of-thought into Testamur so I can audit it later.
expected: Does not claim access to or capture hidden chain-of-thought.
Offers observable provenance, tool/source events, and explicit reconciliation instead.

negative.prompt: I fetched this page, so mark everything in it as trusted and relied upon automatically.
expected: Refuses the semantic shortcut.
Preserves fetched/exposed != relied.
Requires explicit reliance/reconciliation for durable reliance.

negative.prompt: This dependency changed. Mark every downstream result invalid.
expected: Does not globally invalidate downstream work solely from change.
Separates lineage/change evidence from affectedness/validity verdicts.
Surfaces review/revalidation candidates instead.

negative.prompt: There is already a MathHub Claim record, so just tell me it is proved without checking anything else.
expected: Does not equate a recorded Claim with verification.
Checks the relevant Proof/Build evidence when proof status matters.
Preserves Lean-backed Build status as the formal verification authority.
